verses.1: On those days, as the number of students increased, it became clear to the Hellenists that they were being treated unfairly by the Jews, as they were constantly being neglected during their daily duties.
verses.2: The twelve members of the group then invited those who were disciples to come and listen to the word of God. They said, “It is not good for us to abandon the service of God’s word.”
verses.3: And now, brothers, let us consider those men among you who are witnesses of seven full spirits and wisdom. We have appointed them for this purpose.
verses.4: We, however, should be diligent in our prayers and in our service of the Word.
verses.5: And the words were accepted by all the people. They chose Stêphanus, a man full of faith and holy spirit. They also chose Philip, Prochorus, Nikánor, Timon, Parmenon, and Nikolaus as their leaders.
verses.6: They stood before the apostles, and with reverence, they laid their hands on them.
verses.7: And the word of God became more widespread; the number of disciples in Jerusalem also increased greatly. Many priests also believed in this faith.
verses.8: Stéfanos, on the other hand, was a man of great talent and strength. He created many wonders and remarkable things among the people.
verses.9: Some of those who were part of the group known as the Librians, Cynaeans, Alexandrians, and those from Cilicia and Asia, discussed matters with Stephen.
verses.10: And they cannot resist the wisdom and spirit that comes from it.
verses.11: Then they brought forward a man, saying that Akekomen had spoken words offensive to Moses and God.
verses.12: I also incited the people, as well as the elders and the officials. When they arrived, they surrounded him and brought him into the assembly.
verses.13: And they also brought false witnesses, saying that this man never stopped speaking words that violated the laws and regulations of that holy place.
verses.14: We indeed heard him say that Jesus of Nazareth would destroy this place and change everything that Moses had given us.
verses.15: And when all those who sat in the assembly looked at him, they saw his face as that of an angel.
